definition_zh: 车辆刚体沿竖直方向的平动运动。
usage_note: 正文车辆简化模型对车体及转向架考虑浮沉与点头，轮对仅垂向运动。

complete_examples.text: The car body and bogie have bounce and pitch motions and the wheel-set only has a vertical vibration; therefore, there are 10 degrees of freedom for each vehicle.
